summary: Great Western Trail: New Zealand swaps cattle for sheep and wool, layering in breed diversification on top of the familiar deck-building and rondel movement of the GWT series. It's aimed at fans of the system who want a new puzzle rather than a reinvention.
praised: new sheep/wool angle keeps the formula fresh
rewards long-term deck planning like the original
criticised: very close to prior entries mechanically, limited novelty for burned-out fans
still a heavy, long game with steep onboarding
niche appeal outside existing GWT fans

interaction.detail: Players compete for limited trail spots and buildings while otherwise developing separate decks and boards, mirroring the interaction pattern of the base game.

scoring.how_you_win: Score points continuously by delivering increasingly valuable sheep, then add end-game bonuses from buildings and worker-track progress once the final round is triggered.
